definition: Projected radius from the LMC centre of the most distant SMASH detection of its old main-sequence stars, 21 degrees at 50 kpc.
quote: Very extended stellar populations out to R ~ 21 degrees, or ~18.5 kpc
presentation: Where the galaxy's stars are still measured: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary.
